attacks.name: Machine-gun burst
attacks.description: Tracks a visible target, then fires three quick machine-gun shots with slight spread. Move across the aim line between bursts.

attacks.name: Aimed cannon shell
attacks.description: Tracks the target and fires a fast single cannon shell down the barrel line. Step across the line after it commits.

attacks.name: Twin cannon shells
attacks.description: Fires two parallel cannon shells from offset muzzles. Clear the paired lane rather than trying to squeeze through its center.

attacks.name: Rail shot
attacks.description: Holds a longer preferred range and fires a very fast, narrow shot. Reposition during its warning and cooldown.

attacks.name: Machine-gun burst
attacks.description: Sweeps while calm, then tracks visible targets and fires five-shot machine-gun bursts. Its base stays still.

attacks.name: Sweeping surveillance
attacks.description: Sweeps its field of view and raises awareness when it spots the player. This device does not fire projectiles.

attacks.name: Three-way rocket volley
attacks.description: Launches a three-way spread of briefly homing missiles. The missiles can be shot down; keep moving away from their turn.

attacks.name: Assault rifle
attacks.description: Closes around cover, stops at firing distance, and sends aimed rifle rounds toward the exposed player.

attacks.name: Three-way laser fan
attacks.description: Advances around cover until it has sight, then releases a three-way laser fan. The center and both side bolts are real projectiles.

attacks.name: Hunter missile pass
attacks.description: Sways across the road while flying downscreen, launching aimed, shootable missiles every two seconds. Intercept the rockets before they reach the truck.

attacks.name: Gun-truck pursuit
attacks.description: Pulls alongside the chase and sways while firing aimed machine-gun rounds. Close contact also damages the player truck.

attacks.name: Running rifle pursuit
attacks.description: Runs up the road toward the truck, gradually closing sideways and firing aimed rifle shots. Reaching the truck causes a collision hit.

attacks.name: Elite road pursuit
attacks.description: Runs faster than standard pursuers and fires a laser bolt every 1.5 seconds. Avoid letting it reach the truck.

attacks.name: Moving broadside
attacks.description: Traverses the arena while both surviving arm guns fire repeated machine-gun volleys. Destroying an arm removes its shots.

attacks.name: Visor volley
attacks.description: Commits its aim, then releases six alternating visor volleys with a small angular sweep. It recovers before choosing another attack.

attacks.name: Homing missile salvo
attacks.description: Fires four paired salvos from surviving arm racks. Missiles turn briefly, accelerate, and can be shot down.

attacks.name: Committed ram
attacks.description: Marks the lane green, yellow, then red with its direction locked from the start. Move out of that lane and punish its recovery.

attacks.name: Three gate sentries
attacks.description: Three heavy robot sentries defend a closed gate with twin cannon shots. Destroy all three to open the gate. This is the retained earlier Fortress encounter; the current mission ends with Gosfer.

attacks.name: Foundry twin-gun spread
attacks.description: Fires six machine-gun rounds from two muzzles in a three-way spread. Destroying the turret stops the volley.

attacks.name: Bastion shield
attacks.description: For three seconds of each nine-second cycle, its surviving special module reduces incoming damage to the other pieces. The shield does not reflect shots.

attacks.name: Vector laser splitter
attacks.description: Fires three laser bolts while its special module survives; destroying that module removes the side bolts and leaves one center shot.

attacks.name: Redline rocket spread
attacks.description: Fires three briefly homing, shootable missiles. Destroying the special module removes the side missiles.

attacks.name: Redline breach
attacks.description: In the final two seconds of its seven-second cycle, the intact tank speeds toward the player and rams cover. Destroy a track or special module to prevent the breach.

attacks.name: Independent machine guns
attacks.description: Each surviving side gun tracks the player and fires a short three-round burst. Destroy each gun to remove that stream.

attacks.name: Warned cannon spread
attacks.description: A yellow aiming cone turns red as the turret commits, followed by three heavy shells and a recoil recovery.

attacks.name: Six-missile rack
attacks.description: A lock-on warning precedes six missiles from surviving pods. These missiles home briefly, accelerate, and can be shot down.

attacks.name: Cover-smashing ram
attacks.description: Tracks during green, locks through yellow and red, then charges in a straight line. A wall impact stalls it and exposes the hull.

attacks.name: Sonic nova
attacks.description: Charges, then releases a circular sonic burst with three adjacent positions omitted as a usable opening. The next nova changes the gap.

attacks.name: Sonic wall crossing
attacks.description: Marks a safe crossing lane before releasing a horizontal wall of downward sonic waves. Move into the marked opening before release.

attacks.name: 40-watt laser burst

attacks.description: Every third movement phase uses a seven-bolt fan with a wider spread and a longer pause before the next burst.

attacks.name: Reflex sidestep
attacks.description: Detects nearby player shots and makes a short sideways dodge, then resumes its firing cycle. Its dodge has a cooldown.
